name: izero
description: Local-first cognitive memory for Claude Code. Decay/consolidation/graph + offline ONNX embeddings. No cloud, no API key — memory stays at ~/.isotope_zero/.

db_path.title: izero store path
db_path.description: Path to the local SQLite memory store. Defaults to ~/.isotope_zero/isotope_zero.db — memory never leaves this machine. Not sensitive: no API key, no credentials, just a local file path.
